name: Philips Avent Bottle Nipple Anti Colic Teat Medium Flow 2pc - 3m+
description:
Brand: Philips Avent
Product Type: Baby Bottle Nipple / Teat
Quantity: 2 pcs
Age Group: 3 months+
Origin: Made in Indonesia

Features & Benefits:

Includes 2 medium flow nipples, suitable for babies 3 months and above.

Naturally shaped nipple helps babies transition easily between breast and bottle feeding.

Anti-colic valve design reduces air intake, helping to minimize gas, fussiness, and colic.

BPA-free and safe for babies.

Soft, durable silicone for comfortable feeding.
